primary_source.authors: Lawrence Ein, Mircea Mustata, Takehiko Yasuda
primary_source.title: Jet schemes, log discrepancies and Inversion of Adjunction
primary_source.exact_import: Theorems0.1/1.6 give equality mld(W;X,B+cY)=mld(W;B,cY|B) for EVERY nonempty proper closed subsetW of the normal Cartier divisorB in smoothX,with c>=0 andB not contained inY. Definition1.1 uses centres CONTAINED inW;Corollary1.8 supplies lc nearB. Proof of1.6 read on complete page14.
primary_source.application: Upstairs smooth P3 boundaryB=P1xP1,or the smooth quadric boundary,has only critical left fibres as lc centres. At a closed point on one such fibre the right coefficient is<1,so the SNC boundary mld is positive. The imported equality excludes an ambient lc place centred at that point. On an open set away from the critical fibres,boundary klt/ambient plt excludes other exceptional lc places.
primary_source.limitations: An OPTIONAL independent classical route for the closed-point step in GSTRICTPURELEADING20261116;the retained proof already gives a Cartier perturbation argument. The paper does not prove the exceptional Haar period theorem,thin closure,all-valuations root lemma,or either full MZ assertion.

local_argument_audit.equality: Finite boundary vH>=ka and lc A>=a+vH/k force A>=2a. A pole has A=2a,vH=ka,and order-1.
local_argument_audit.finite_cover: For v=t^e,an extension Eprime of E with ramificationrho retains pole order rho*(-1)+(rho-1)=-1. Pulled original volume e*unit*dt dz/t^(e+1) therefore gives A(Eprime)=(e+1)ord(t).
local_argument_audit.root_inequalities: Each smooth transverse pair(t=0)+(z-phi_i(t)=0) is SNC,so ord(z-phi_i)<=e*ord(t). Their sum equals k*e*ord(t),forcing equality for EVERY root,with repetitions retained.
local_argument_audit.conclusion: Root differences have t-order>=e. Their average liesK[[v]] with zero constant,hence t-order>=e. All roots have that order;all Weierstrass coefficients have v-order>=their index. Numerator multiplicity>=k contradicts the retained <k condition. No valuation of the generic centre field is introduced.
local_argument_audit.audit_result: No new concrete gap found in these local steps. This is internal mathematical scrutiny,NOT independent replay,formal verification or external review;projective-period gluing was not independently certified.

redundant_attempt.attempted: Use antipodal reality and u-parity on the SL2 quadric to exclude every polynomial in an arbitrary mixed real seed.
redundant_attempt.relation_to_retained: Already SUBSUMED by GSTRICTPURELEADING20261116 and GFULLTHINRADICAL20261116,which were found on the fresh shared ledger before registration. No new claim or duplicate canonical proof is created.
redundant_attempt.alternative_sketch: On the double cover transverse coordinates(u,v),H is even in u. A finite volume pole would force A=3ord(u),vH=2kord(u). After root splitting u=s^e,SNC inequalities force every root difference to order>=2e. The root mean is even in u with zero constant,so has order>=2e. Weighted numerator order for weights(1,2) is>=2k;the actual torus weights of the full phase have one weak sign. Self-adjointness forces weight0,so a real seed with a pole is torus-fixed. The retained stronger PGL2 theorem already avoids needing this alternate argument.

generic_trace_rejection.algebra: For q>1,Tr_(K(t)/K(Y))(1/Yprime)=0 by the simple-root partial fraction identity over K(Y);thus the generic rational trace of1/W is0.
generic_trace_rejection.boundary: This trace is not an identity for the original Haar cycle. The retained Haar-residue theorem shows that the rational slice regular locus carries no ambient Haar H3 class:the cycle cannot avoid its poles. Exceptional/nonproper boundary terms cannot be discarded.
generic_trace_rejection.disposition: Discard the proposed trace-only unweighted transfer. This does not exclude every actual unweighted period relation or every composite.
